batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b HV Patel

batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b SN Thakur

batting.name: Washington Sundar

batting.name: Navdeep Saini
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b Imran Tahir

balls.text: makes it 37 off the over! And only a few yards short of making it 39. They gave him a chance and boy has he made them pay. Utter domination. This is overpitched on leg stump, he clears the front leg and swipes it over square leg

fifth six of the over! Harshal has completely come apart! This is RCB's man at the death this season, who's done so so well. He's run into Jadeja and he's run out of answers. It's a full toss in the corridor and Jadeja clubs it over long-on. 33 off the over so far
dropped at extra cover. Low full toss pushed wide outside off, reaches out and nearly clears the fiedler for four. He jumps with the perfect timing and gets two hands on it, but can't hold on

pulled to deep midwicket's left! Brings up at 25-ball fifty! Unreal batting this. Harshal is flustered. It's a slower short ball, but there's room on it as it's outside off. And he uses that swinging room to clear the boundary

smoked over deep midwicket and could be no-ball for height! Yes it is! Harshal goes around the wicket and serves up a baseball swing for Jadeja and he has slaughtered that. It's outside off and above waist height, and it has been punished
misses the length on his yorker and is punished. Full at middle stump, clears the front leg and nails the slog once more
swung between long-on and deep midwicket. Flat and over the line. It's a cutter at good length on middle stump. He clears the front leg and swings it off the middle
yorker length at middle stump, mistimed slog to deep midwicket's right and they won't take Kohli on for the second as he slides and recovers
switches up his length and Jadeja gets four off the top edge. Sharp bouncer at middle stump, Jadeja in terrible position for the hook. It sails over the keeper
yorker at leg stump, looks to turn that behind short fine but gets an inside edge onto pad
yorker at leg stump, jammed to deep midwicket's right
yorker at middle stump, drilled back down the pitch and Siraj sticks out a hand to stop it
full at middle stump, clears the front leg and slogs along the floor to deep midwicket's right
full at middle stump, steps out and whips to deep midwicket on the bounce
full offcutter outside off, pitches just inside and then turns past the marker. Called wide
full at leg stump, driven along the ground to long-on
full slower ball outside off, leans in and has a stab at that. Beaten

picks out deep square. Offcutter at a length outside off, gets his weight into the off side and looks to swish that over the fine leg boundary. No pace on it, and he's not in the best shape right now either. Can't get enough power on that to clear Jamieson
low full toss at middle stump, flicked to deep square's left
full at middle stump, drilled to long-on
low full toss at middle stump, clears the front leg and drives to mid-off's right
full at middle stump, looks to power that straight off the front foot, gets a thick inside edge to deep square's leg left
slower ball at a length outside off, punched to deep point's left and they come back for a second that ends up with Rayudu limping as he stretches to get back into the crease

hits him on the boot with a yorker outside leg stump. Jadeja wants to flick that through midwicket and misses. Siraj flicks the ball onto the stumps as Jadeja threatens to run. Then turns around and asks about the lbw
full and just outside off, steps out and yorks himself. That trickles past the off stump

slower ball at a length on middle stump, opens the face and stabbed to deep point's right. A decent throw comes in on the bounce and they send this upstairs but Jadeja had judged that run nicely. He's grounded safely

oh that is brutal! Superb hit. Steps down at this offcutter on middle stump and gets such a big swing through the line as he launches it over long-on. Whew. You'd think a spinner was bowling, the kind of bat swing he's managed to generate here. Ridiculously good hands from Rayudu
short of a length and just outside off, cut to backward point's left
full slower ball at middle stump, walks into an off-stump guard. Flicks with the angle to deep square
slower ball at a length outside off, jabbed to short third with the angle
length and at leg stump, waits on that and gently stabs it past short fine
lofted over mid-off. Friendly full delivery outside off, clears the front leg and uses minimal effort to get this over the infield

now a misfield at deep square. Is the heat getting to RCB? Length at middle stump, hurried aerial sweep to Padikkal's left. He's always going to have to retrieve this on the bounce, but he misjudges it and ends up flapping at it. Deflects off him and into the boundary

Christian puts down an easy one at deep midwicket! Oh that could cost them dearly. Short of a length at leg stump, pulled firmly and flat. He got down on a knee and looked to receive it stomach height. It pops out and he can't get a hand on the second attempt
short of a length and sliding on, tight at middle and off. Chopped to point
short of a length just outside off, backs away and pushes to backward point
length and gripping and turning from middle stump, looks for the sweep and cops that on the left hand
length and turning into off stump, opens the face and chops it to short third
slower ball at a length on middle stump, defended into the leg side

taken at long-on! Yet again Harshal is on a hat-trick! Must be the third time this season. Offcutter, short and turning into middle stump. It's an attempted aerial pull, but he can't go through it because that stops on him. Christian runs to the left and takes that smartly. Two new batsmen at the crease suddenly for CSK
dragged out to deep midwicket. Offcutter at a length, at middle stump. Raina jumping down leg side and reaching out this time for the slog. Can't get distance on it and Padikkal takes it comfortably
nearly bowls him! Offcutter delivered from wide of the crease, straightens after pitching on leg. Raina is scrambling down leg and looks to open the face last minute. That misses leg stump
full slower ball outside off, clears the front leg and looks to steer that to third man. Beaten as that rises past the bat
offcutter at a length on middle stump, leans in and smothers the bounce to get a single to square leg. And that brings up a second consecutive fifty for Faf

not very convincing, but very effective! A short one, he's almost waiting for it. It arrives and it is way down leg side. He just extends his arms and has a hopeful swipe at it, and manages to get it over the fine leg boundary
beaten. Good length and rising from outside leg stump. He walks into the leg side and looks to swing it over midwicket
short of a length and in at middle stump, backs away for the punch through cover and that hurries onto him. Mistimed pat to mid-off
short of a length outside off, hangs inside the line and steers to third man
length and in at middle stump, clears the front leg and looks to punch over the bowler. Bat slips in his hand and he's called for a change of gloves after getting a single at long-on
heaved over midwicket. Short of a length and tight at middle stump, swivels the upper body and drags this over the infielder
short of a length and sliding on outside off, chopped straight to backward point
length at middle stump, punched back to the bowler

hoicked over long-on. Didn't get to the pitch of that but it slid on and he went through with the shot. Length outside off, jumps down at it and goes full-fledged slog, enough to get it over the fielder
full at middle stump, looks to sweep and gets an inside edge onto pad
length and sliding into middle stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length and turning into leg stump, whipped to deep square
full at off stump, steps out and drills it straight into the bowler's path
length and slanted in from wide of the crease again, this time he uses that angle to slog this to midwicket's right
length ball, offcutter and sliding in from wide of the crease. Punched back to the bowler
slower ball at a length on leg stump, shuffles and tickles it to short fine
full and into leg stump from around the wicket, cops that on the pad as he looks to flick
offcutter at a length outside off, looks to force that through cover, gets it to long-on off the thick inside edge
lifted over long-on. Length ball at middle stump, jumps down the track and clubs it off the middle
length at turning in at middle stump, blocked on the front foot
length at leg stump, jabbed through midwicket with soft hands

he was trundling to the non-strikers end and would have been out by miles! Chahal doesn't get behind the stumps to receive that. I mean...he's behind the stumps, but he's not in position to try and gather this throw from AB. Length at leg stump, dropped pitch side and that looked a proper struggle for Raina, he was not prepared as Faf called him
full outside off, driven through over on the front foot

taken at deep square. You'll remember that straight six he hit off Chahal, where he got into sweeping position. Gets in that position again, but this one dips on him faster and he's ended up not getting close to it at middle stump. Has to stretch out, can't possibly go straight from there, and ends up carving it up for the fielder to run in and hold
full slower ball at leg stump, keeps low and gets him on the pad as he looks to flick
lovely work at deep midwicket from Padikkal. Low full toss at leg stump, gets his flick away with great timing. Padikkal flies to his right and lands hard into the turf, but he manages to stop it
full slower ball at middle stump, gets forward and flicks to long-on
full and just outside off, driven on the rise to long-off
big appeal for lbw is turned down. That was very full when he missed on the flick, but might have been down leg side. They don't review
offcutter, full and down leg side. Left alone
full slower ball at leg stump, flicked to deep square
offcutter at a length outside off, waits on it and steers to third man
short ball at middle stump, another offcutter. Walks down at that and adjusts nicely to swipe this to deep square's right
slower ball, short of a length at leg stump. Jabbed to midwicket's left from the crease
slower ball outside off, defended into the off side

Sundar lunges and gets hands on it but he's moving quickly and the momentum means this trickles into the boundary at deep point. Short of a length outside off, stretches his hands and slashes this square. No nuance, he went for the kill there
length and just outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover

swung straight over the bowler! Again, all shape and balance from Gaikwad. This is tossed up at middle and off. Gets forward, in a position from where he can bring out the slog sweep if he wants. On this occasion, he just launches it straight
full at middle stump, gets to the pitch and drives straight to extra cover
googly, picked. Short of a length outside off and he shuffles to punch to deep midwicket
short of a length outside off, cut to sweeper's left and he can't collect cleanly as they come back for the second
full and pitching outside leg, appeal for lbw turned down as he misses on the flick
length and turning away from leg stump, blocked on the front foot
sweeeeet. A cover drive of the highest aesthetic value. It's an overpitched ball just outside off and he gets low and leans in to find the boundary off the last ball of the powerplay
yorker length just outside off, clears the front leg and jabs towards mid-off
full and wide outside off, looks to steer that between short third and backward point. Finds the latter
slower short ball just outside off, backs into the leg side and slaps this past cover point off the back foot
short ball, offcutter spinning into the body. Pulled to deep midwicket
misfield at mid-off from Kohli and the siren goes off too. Low full toss following him down leg side. He punches straight to the fielder and Kohli lets it through. They don't run for the misfield
good length at middle stump, punched to deep midwicket off the back foot
turns it square. Pitches leg, draws him forward on length, and rips it past the outside edge
full at middle stump, leans in and drives with the turn to extra cover
outside edge stopped with a dive to the left at short third. Length ball at off stump, looks to drive with the front leg in the leg side
length outside off, gets forward and drives to long-off
oh nicely put away. That came on slow but he held his shape and punched this past cover. It was length, turning away from off stump, slowly. Held his shape beautifully
short of a length, a legbreak outside off. Backs away for the cut and gets it into the pitch off the under-edge
short of a length just outside off, shuffles into line and punches straight to cover. Disappointed with himself
slower ball at a length, following him down leg side. Backs away and pushes into the covers
full slower ball at middle stump, steps out and has to reach out and look to drag this. Thick inside edge down to fine leg
short and wide outside off, hangs back and slices it over backward point
beaten on the outside edge. Short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and the ball rushes past

lifted over mid-on. A clear pattern of boundary scoring from the openers so far. Length and angled into the stumps. Not to the pitch this time and not as free-flowing, just manages to stab it over and that is enough
full at leg stump, flicked straight to square leg
yorker at leg stump, hurriedly jabs it pitch side on the leg side. Siraj slides to his right, picks up and has a throw at the stumps
lofted over mid-off! All balance. Length ball just outside off, jumps down at it and is so still upon contact. Makes some room and swings through the line with an angled bat
length and slanted into middle stump, defended down the pitch
length and just outside off, opens the face and runs it to short third

steps out and whips it over the long-on boundary. Stylish, this. It's a full ball slanted into the stumps, he steps out and meets it at the pitch and whips his wrists quickly to get this flying into his dugout
good length outside off, gets forward and pushes with hard hands. It floats out to mid-off
low full toss at leg stump, flicked to midwicket's right
full and into leg stump, leans in and flicks to fine leg
good length and down leg side, left alone
full inswinger at middle stump, driven off the inside half to mid-on's right
good length and curving away, defended into the covers
beats the outside edge. Short of a length and some shape away in the corridor, jabs at it and is beaten
past the outside edge. Length from wide of the crease and straightening in the corridor as he looks to get forward
yorekr at leg stump, surprises him but he manages to chop down at this and get it to fine leg. It turns into a Natmeg by the time he's done
slower ball at a length outside off, punched on the up to mid-off
length and just outside off, punched on the up to mid-off
springs into this overpitched ball and it's rapidly past extra cover. Full and just outside off with a touch of shape away. Gets his weight forward and drives along the ground
length and into leg stump, nudged to fine leg with the angle
yorker at middle stump, a helicopter shot, off the inside part to short fine's left
full dipping slower ball outside off, leans in and drives. Thick outside edge falls to Jadeja's right and, no, he can't take that catch
low full toss at leg stump, driven down to long-on
slower length ball at middle stump, looks for the sweep, ends up slicing into vacant deep square
pumped over deep midwicket! Full slower ball at middle stump, clears the front leg and gives this a proper slog to clear the field
dipping slower ball wide outside off, Siraj waits and has a late chop. Beaten
length and into leg stump, flicked out to deep square
short of a length and rising in the corridor, extremely late on the late cut
slower ball at a length in the corridor, beaten on the slog
full and floating away outside off, backs away, slashes, misses
length and just outside off, backs away and swings, beaten
full and wide outside off, slashed out to sweeper cover

a silent appeal from Dhoni, a raised finger from the umpire, a review immediately from Siraj. And then he takes his gloves and helmet off to shake hands. Peak village cricket. It's a short ball outside off, he looks to pull, there's a sound. We're waiting for Ultra Edge to determine what it is...it looks like a flat line! Is it professional if the rest of my commentary is 56 HA(s) jammed together?
slower ball at a length outside off, whipped to long-on off the front foot
length outside off, defended into the covers
Jadeja gets the direct hit and that bat was plonking down. But just in. He stabbed that to point's right off the back foot and for his bravery, gets overthrows as the ball deflects off the stumps
full and just outside off, pushed out to sweeper
length and just outside off, pushed through the covers off the front foot
length and just outside off, looks to drive and is beaten
length outside off, stabs and misses
short of a length at leg stump, swiped to fine leg off the hips
length at off stump, defended down the pitch
short and wide outside off, beaten on the cut
good length at off stump, defended to point

Tahir's got a direct hit from square leg and Jamieson is walking back! Full ball squeezed out towards square leg, he's sent back and stretching, but he's nowhere close! Tahir waits, takes aim, and throws the stumps down
full and wide outside off, slashes and misses

oh that's a good grab but he can't keep his feet in order! Santner is disappointed in himself at long-on. Slower ball, short and slapped flat. Santner grabs it but his right foot lands on the boundary padding
dipping slower full toss outside off, reaches out and drives to long-on
just past off stump. Dipping offbreak at a length outside off, Chahal looks to stab towards third man and is beaten on the inside edge
yorker tailing in outside off, clears the front leg and gets it to long-on off the toe-end
slower short ball wide outside off, left alone
length outside off, reaches out and slashes to point
short of a length and flying though outside off, beaten on the late cut
short of a length just outside off, punched off the back foot to point
short of a length just outside off, clears the front leg and drives on the rise to mid-off
knuckle ball, floating away from a length outside off. Beaten on the cut
full at off stump, gets forward and pats that into the leg side

Dhoni reluctantly reviews the lbw. Tahir made a long case for it. Chahal's caught in front of off stump trying to defend a googly. That spun in from outside off, it's very close on the bat-pad situation. At one point the ball is really close to the inside edge, and at the same point the low part of that bat appears to be touching the pad. The origins of the murmur on Ultra Edge will not be clear in this case. Third umpire deems it an edge. Chahal survives
legbreak at a length on middle stump, blocked on the front foot
short of a length slider at off stump, defended off the back foot
legbreak at a length outside off, Chahal lets it go

sharp take from Raina! Another slider, short of a length outside off. Saini has a quick slash at this. Raina was moving to his right instinctively for the cut, but this speeds into his mid-riff, low to his left, and he reacts fast
googly spins down leg side from a good length, past the flick
full at off stump, driven towards long-off and past Jadeja's boot to the left
full at middle stump, looks to drive that straight, gets a thick inside edge to short fine's left
full at off stump, driven to long-off
length outside off, defended on the front foot
length and sliding on at middle stump, hurried stabbed into the midwicket region
short of a length just outside off, punched to extra cover with the turn
slides into middle stump! Harshal back in the crease for the pull, doesn't pick the slider. Tahir back after  long time, gets his first
googly, short of a length at middle and turning into the pad as he looks to whip that
slider at a length, down leg side and past the attempted glance
full at off stump, driven down the pitch with the turn
full at leg stump, driven firmly to long-on
outside edge and no slip. Length ball turning away from middle stump, pushes on the front foot and is caught inside the line
short of a length slider at off stump, punched back to the bowler off the toe-end
length outside off, driven off the outside edge to backward point
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length and tight at middle and leg, blocked on the front foot

and another! Sounds like it anyway but RCB have reviewed. Short of a length and turning away wide outside off. There's a sound as the ball goes through to Dhoni, the batter was looking to cut that. We await Ultra Edge...and there is some distance and a flat line. So a prudent review, that will be overturned
full at leg stump, cops that on the pads as he looks to flick

no way! Jadeja is like an Under-23 player playing in the Under-11s nets right now. He is managing to embarrass the entirety of RCB, and who bigger than AB de Villiers? He has completely outfoxed him. Length ball, drifted and dipping into leg stump. AB reaches out from the crease and wants to stab that on the front foot. It turns past quickly and hits the top of middle. Stunning, simply stunning performance this
short of a length slider, mistimed whip off the back foot to long-on
full slider at leg stump, flicked to deep square

looks like a Jadeja direct hit, and as ever, it looks out. This is just pure bullying from Jadeja and CSK. Once again, they're making RCB look very ordinary. This was a short of a length legbreak outside of, punched to Jadeja's left and Christian doesn't have the legs to beat this throw. His third straight score of 1
full at off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
legbreak at length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
slider at length on middle stump, pushed into the leg side from the crease
length and tight at the stumps, pushed back down the pitch
tonks leg stump! Slows it down, slides it on. Maxwell clears the front leg and looks to slog that over deep midwicket. Through it early and misses completely. Jadeja continues to torment RCB
short of a length at middle stump, mistimed pull to deep midwicket
slider at middle stump, back of a length. Pushed to deep midwicket
oh nicely placed. Short of a length at middle stump, and he uses quick feet to get on the back foot and create some room before punching this to the extra cover boundary
length and just outside off, clears the front leg and blazes that to extra cover. Dhoni was just telling Jadeja to keep it tight because Maxwell likes to hit it there
length at off stump, sliding on and tight. Opens the face and runs this to point off the front foot
full and just outside off, clears the front leg and drills that down to long-off
length and turning away from middle stump, lofted drive, out of control, down to long-off
full at leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
slider at middle stump, hurriedly punched to long-on's right and just makes it back at the other end, does AB
short of a length outside off, looks to punch that off the back foot. Thick outside edge to backward point's right
short of a length just outside off, cut straight to backward point
beaten on the drive. And it is sent upstairs for the stumping. Flat length ball dipping and turning outside off, looks to drive on the rise. Marginal movement of the back foot, but he's safely inside
length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
slow-mo lunge at backward point from Bravo. And they sneak two. Length and turning away outside off, jabs with the turn to the fielder's left and sweeper is needed to clean that up
taken at deep midwicket. Length at middle stump, a panic-driven jump down the pitch. Nowhere close to meeting that ball. Can only drag it high for Gaikwad
length and turning into middle stump, punched down the pitch off the back foot

confusion in the covers as this goes through Bravo and Jadeja who are close in together at cover and point. It's a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot. Sweeper point runs to the right and retrieves
bouncer outside off, gets a little too steep and he pulls out after shaping for the hook
full slower ball at off stump, driven firmly to mid-off
too easy. Length and wide outside off, reaches out and drives along the ground to split cover and extra
full slower ball outside off, arches back and opens the face to slice this through backward point
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and runs it to third man

taken at backward square! The bowling change has worked out. Thakur slams another in short, tight at Padikkal's body, and that is definitely a vulnerable area for him. Late on the pull and it floats out to Raina
dragged over mid-on but can't beat Faf running for it. Length at middle stump, lofted on the rise. Faf pulls it back in at the line
bouncer at a middle stump line, through him quickly as he looks for the hook
full at the stumps, driven straight to mid-on
short of a length at leg stump again, looks to tickle it fine once more and can't make connection this time. Deflected off the thigh guard to deep backward square's left
length and curved into the pads, stands tall and tickles it fine
length at middle stump, flicked to deep square's right
loopy slower ball at 88kph! Full and wide outside off, Sundar has thought of about three shots by the time that's arrived, and he's missed on the cover drive ultimately
length ball, slow and at leg stump. Tickles it fine and can't beat Dhoni down the leg side
full slower ball at middle stump, flicked to midwicket
length and just outside off, defended into the covers
superb execution from Curran! Slower ball, dug right into the pitch, short of a length outside off. Kohli looks to cut and that gets big on him. Thick outside edge and an easy take
shovels it past short fine! This is some form from DDP. Short and into his hips, gets the front leg in the air and closes the face to swipe this to the long leg boundary
short of a length onto pads, looks to tickle that fine and catches in on the thigh guard. Annoyed with himself straight away
slower ball at a length just outside off, jabs it to short third

hammered to the extra cover boundary! Dropped short and just outside off, gets a front foot press at this and then slams it on the rise, aerial but safely to extra cover's right. Sweeper won't get close
just inside the boundary. Length ball just outside off, exposes the stumps to make room and swings around the line. Off the low part of the bat and enough to beat Bravo running backwards
length ball down leg side, past his attempted glance
full at middle stump, steps out and drives along the floor to long-on

mistimed loft over mid-off as he steps out at this length ball outside off. Tahir chases and just about pulls it back in. he was on his knees, facing the boundary. Managed to release the ball flicking it backwards before he slid into the padding

oh supreme. This is a shot of some class. Full and just outside off. he reaches out and opens the face at the perfect moment to place this and keep power on it. Enough to get it over the point boundary
short of a length and just outside off, steers it to short third's right
slower ball, at a length and very wide outside off. Left alone
length and just outside off, jabbed to short third with an open face
whipped over deep square! Full and sliding onto leg stump, gets the front foot forward and just helps that along the way
full and shaped into middle stump, shuffles and flicks to deep square
full slower ball at middle stump, punched to mid-on off the front foot
bouncer dug in too short outside off, left alone
short of a length and just outside off, chopped into the covers off the under-edge
flowy and delicious from Padikkal. Full outside off, uses his high backlift to languidly drive through the line, over his partner at the other end
length and a hint of shape inwards outside off, left alone
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to deep backward square
whipped to the long leg boundary. If there's one man you want to counter-punch a team, this one is it. Gets a freebie on leg stump and whips it fine of the fielder
